sloka: ततः पावक सम्काशम् आरुरोह रथ उत्तमम् ।वैयाघ्रम् पुरुष्व्या घो राजितम् राजनम्दनः ॥२-१६-२८॥
transliteration: tataḥ pāvaka samkāśam āruroha ratha uttamam ।vaiyāghram puruṣvyā gho rājitam rājanamdanaḥ ॥2-16-28॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, met all his friends in the middle courtyard. Having seen them all eager to see him, he approached and greeted them. Thereafter, he mounted the best silver chariot covered with tigerskin and glowing like fire.
translations.hindi: हा ! धिक्कार है! हे देवि! तुमको ऐसी बात कहनी उचित नहीं। मैं महाराज के कहने से और कामों की तो कोई वात ही नहीं, अग्नि में गिरने को तैयार हूँ
